meaning: Do and go on; away from now.

examples.japanese: これからも頑張っていく。
examples.reading: これからもがんばっていく。
examples.gloss: I will keep on doing my best.

examples.reading: あるいていきましょう。

usage: Do something and go on: 持っていく (take along), 変わっていく (keep on changing), 頑張っていく (keep going).
It looks forward, away from now or from the speaker.

compare.difference: ていく looks forward and away. てくる looks back and toward the speaker.
